dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: Single horizontal white band visible across the greater coverts with high grayscale contrast against dark wing feathers.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Visible pale-gray to white edges on primary and secondary feathers providing sharp linear boundaries against dark feather centers.

crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.nape_patch_geometry: High-contrast, irregular white trapezoidal patch located on the posterior neck.
crown_and_nape_macro_patterns.crown_to_mantle_demarcation: Sharp linear transition between black crown and white nape patch; less distinct transition from nape/black collar to olive-gray mantle.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a high-contrast white cheek patch partially visible on the lateral side of the head.
